collection.description: A traveler hints that people in their former home were once held against their will and made to work.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (traveler), a traveler, hints that people in their former home were once held against their will and made to work.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (traveler) speaks only as much as they wish.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: They decline the subject and join an ordinary meal.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (traveler) chooses their work and resting place.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: They ask for time before committing to village duties.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Villagers distinguish shared responsibilities from coercion.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (teen) asks why a rule is fair only when people can question it.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: They build friendships that do not revolve around their past.
